Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the quarterly inspection of the automatic water fire-fighting system on the main and auxiliary transformers.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Din El-Dify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba — General Manager — and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan — Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector. The document was reviewed and approved by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef Suleiman — Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector — and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed — General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator — and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay — Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Tool bag
Cleaning tools
Grease can
Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | The steps are carried out for the transformer whether in service or out of service.
2. | Check the main parts of the system.
3. | Make sure the fire-fighting system is in its normal operating mode through the fire panel.
4. | Make sure the gauges are in good condition.
5. | Make sure the main starting valve is closed.
6. | Make sure of the water pressure of the supply source.
7. | Make sure of the water pressure in the system.
8. | Make sure the alarm is in working order.
9. | Inspect the main drain valve.
10. | Inspect the auxiliary drain valve.
